rule: A PowerShell command or script is handed to the operator only after the VCGC flow has run: policy read, subsystems aligned, then the script. Every such script carries the PS accelerator template and ends with a rich detailed summary matrix report.

flow_first.ai_side: Before writing or changing any PowerShell for the operator, the AI enters VCGC (console tail `status`, seat push off) in the same session and reads the flow lines: [流程] 政策過 · 子系統已對齊 · 才執行.
flow_first.script_side: The script's first step runs the VCGC console tail `status`. If the line '[流程] 政策過' is absent, the script stops before any other step (exit 3) and says why.
flow_first.evidence: The side-car JSON records the flow line and the time; CGC_MDL229 shows it as KPI row 政策 / VCGC 流程 and turns the verdict RED when it is missing.

template.scoped: each Python step wrapped in Invoke-VIACeleritasScoped when the profile defines it (VCGC flow: [加速] PS 用 Invoke-VIACeleritasScoped); otherwise say so and run the step as is
template.python: only through Invoke-VIAPython; if the helper is missing, stop (fail-closed)

renderer: CGC_MDL228_VIADBManager report (newest) for the DB panel
report.form: rich detailed summary matrix: verdict KPI, accelerator, per-step matrices, and a to-do matrix ranked by severity; plain-text fallback with the same matrices when rich is missing; never install rich
report.outputs: HTML + TXT + a paste bundle placed on the clipboard

operator_side: Run by full path or from the repo root launcher; one command per line.
Paste the bundle into the Claude chat, never back into PowerShell.
Network consent gates and package installs stay the operator's hands.

sync.applies_to: every new or changed .ps1 handed to the operator from 2026-09-28 on; existing scripts join when they are next versioned (L04)
sync.check: CGC_MDL229 reads the newest VIA_Policy_PSCommandGate_v*.json and verifies book_sha256_16 against the locked book

do_not: hand over a PowerShell command before the VCGC flow ran
ship a .ps1 without the template stamp, the Celeritas join and the rich summary report
